name: Pollo: Pollo V1.6
description: Pollo 1.6 is Pollo AI's flagship video model, optimized for efficiency. Described as "better, cheaper, and faster," targeting high-quality cinematic outputs, it supports both image-to-video and text-to-video inputs. In practice, 1.6 delivers more realistic and creative animations than previous Pollo versions. It emphasizes speed and cost-effectiveness, making it accessible for a wide range of users. Overall, Pollo 1.6 aims to balance visual fidelity with fast generation, serving as a versatile general-purpose model.
